tasks.short: Read drawings to decide member locations, sizes and counts

steps.what: Read specifications and blueprints for this steel frame
Determine locations, quantities and sizes of materials required

tasks.design: She opens the specifications and blueprints and decides the locations, quantities and sizes herself. She still reads the drawing on the steel. Nothing prepares those counts, sends an order, or raises an alert.
tasks.previous_blocker: The count depends on this drawing and on which members are already standing.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool reads this drawing in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A size on the drawing can disagree with the piece on the ground.
tasks.human_edge: She matches the drawing to the steel in front of her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still opens every drawing and decides every location, size and count.

reach.task: Pick the next member she named from the drawing
reach.learn: Which size and location she read for this lift

evidence.claim: Deciding member locations, sizes and counts from a structural drawing stays with the ironworker who has the drawing and the steel in front of her. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
She opens the drawing and decides locations, quantities and sizes herself. A schedule already printed by the engineer, if any, is still read by her and is not a saving.
No order is sent and no alert is raised. The decided sizes are not filed as a standing version.
unknowns: Whether this contractor's drawings already print a counted schedule of members before she opens them.
research_questions: On a typical week, how often does a size on the drawing differ from the piece delivered to the site?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still opens the drawing and decides every location, size and count, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Lift steel members by crane, forklift or signal

steps.what: Lift steel beams, girders and columns using cranes or forklifts
Give signaling so hoisting equipment operators position structural members

tasks.design: She lifts the beams, girders and columns, and she signals a colleague operator to position the structural members. The signal is live on site and no version is filed. Nothing lists lifts, alerts the crane, or sends an instruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: The load is in the air, and the signal has to match what the operator can see.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool lifts the member or replaces the signal.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong signal can drop a beam on the crew.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the load, the people and the operator in the same moment.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still lifts every member and still signals the operator.

reach.task: Hold the landing clear while the member comes in
reach.learn: The signal she gives before the load moves

evidence.claim: Lifting a structural member and signaling the operator stay with the person on the steel. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
The hoisting operator is a colleague on this contractor's crew, so the signal is internal. It is a gesture or a call, no version is filed, and the step stays ungated.
The lift is not logged with a time or a location. Nothing lists lifts, alerts the crane, or sends an instruction.
unknowns: Whether the operator on mobile-crane lifts is hired with the crane rather than employed by this contractor.
research_questions: How many lifts in a week are signaled to a hired crane firm rather than to a colleague?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still lifts every member and still gives every signal, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is unchanged. She still reads the drawings on the steel, and she still lifts and signals.
reach: The crane operator picks the next member from the size she read.
The site supervisor holds the landing clear while she signals.
skills_to_grow: Match a drawn size to the member on the hook.
Keep the signal visible to the operator while the load turns.
role.ambitious_version: She still reads each drawing and still signals each lift, with a new hand learning the signal beside her.
